title: Move the GitHub token out of `chrome.storage.local` into the OS keychain via
blocker: native messaging. Deferred by design; the token is currently a persisted secret with no keychain protection. Decided 2026-10-11 (Codex, high): stay deferred. Unblocks when a maintained per-machine native-host installer and update path exists, or evidence shows `TRUSTED_CONTEXTS` local storage is insufficient for this owner's threat model.
